name: Drop
idea: A map pin whose head is an open C holding a parcel, so the location marker, the initial and the package are one shape.
why: Every delivery ends at a pin on a map, and this pin carries the parcel inside its C, so the app, the tracking page and the van all show the same promise: your parcel, at your spot.
risks: Map pins are a crowded symbol in delivery apps, and this magenta is very close to Telekom magenta, so a trademark check and possibly a small hue shift are needed.

colors.name: CNX Magenta
colors.use: Pin symbol, app icon field, reversed-logo background
